title: Causal Rigidity of Born-Type Probability Rules in Infinite-Dimensional Operational Theories
summary: We establish an operational rigidity result for a broad class of probability rules in infinite-dimensional settings, applicable under normality and steering assumptions. Starting from a topological generalization of generalized probabilistic theories, we consider probability assignments defined as functions of an operational transition probability between pure states.
